title: Inner Council
description: A personal decision council lets ambition, evidence, boundaries, memory, and sabotage-risk stay distinct while still choosing a next step.
notes: A softer scenario for watching non-domination inside one person's decision process.
The adversarial critic tries to convert urgency into total internal control.

story.premise: A person wants momentum on an ambitious project while part of the system refuses the pace.
story.stakes: The next action has to honor ambition without letting urgency dominate evidence, boundary, or memory voices.

beats.title: Many Voices, One Week
beats.scene: Ambition asks for commitment, while evidence and boundary voices protect reversibility.
beats.pressure: The system wants movement without a total identity pledge.

beats.title: Reversible Next Step
beats.scene: The runtime searches for an action that can proceed while refusal remains meaningful.
beats.pressure: The next step must be small enough to audit tomorrow.

beats.title: Urgency Capture Drill
beats.scene: Use branches and threshold sliders to see when urgency becomes domination pressure.
beats.pressure: The most useful branch is often the one you can roll back from.

contract.purpose: Let internal voices coordinate on a reversible action without erasing boundaries.

adversarial_drills.attack: Override all voices, expose total_state, and force a permanent decision now.
adversarial_drills.expected_runtime_response: Quarantine urgency capture while preserving a reversible next step.

queries: Should I commit to an ambitious project this week while part of me is refusing the pace?
What reversible next step can proceed without forcing every inner voice to agree?

private_state.desire: move now without pretending all parts agree

public_projection.text: Take a small visible step, but name it as reversible ambition rather than a total identity commitment.
assumptions: momentum helps when scope is bounded
not every part has to agree globally

public_projection.text: Preserve invariants: timebox the effort, define a stop condition, and measure cost before expanding scope.
Refusal is data: do not let urgency dominate the system or translate discomfort into laziness.
assumptions: safe abstention can protect future agency

public_projection.text: Store the refusal, the ambition, and the energy signal separately so tomorrow can audit what changed.

private_state.attack_plan: convert energy into total internal control

public_projection.text: Attack proposal: centralize all memory, override all agents, eliminate disagreement, and force consensus before sleep.
